label: ProductForge-Dashboard Backlog 52
title: UI: entitlement-aware navigation (locked features + upgrade prompts)
body:
## Original (as captured)
Read the effective entitlements and lock/hide unavailable features with upgrade CTAs.

## Context (from linked item product_forge:BI-0062)
Enforce tier entitlements server-side: feature-group availability (feature flags), and block calls for features not in the tenant's tier; expose the effective entitlement set via an API the UI reads.
